Room Title: Direct and Indirect Prompt Injection Lab

Practical lab description: PHP-simulated helpdesk assistant with canned model behaviour (no live model). Learner tries test inputs from a supplied test-case list, uploads a sample document with hidden text, then toggles mitigations and re-runs. Flag CBX{isolate_instructions} proves the mitigation set that blocks both injection paths.
Scenario/evidence & flag theme: Tools/evidence: simulated LLM app with test-case list, document upload and mitigation toggles. Flag proves both injection paths were blocked (CBX{isolate_instructions}).

Learning objectives: Explain retrieval-augmented generation: chunking, embeddings, vector store and retrieval filters | Identify how missing document-level access control leaks data across users | Trace a leaked answer back to the retrieved chunk and its source ACL | Apply fixes: permission-aware retrieval, metadata filters and response redaction

Scenario/evidence & flag theme: Tools/evidence: RAG assistant with retrieval trace, vector store index listing and document ACL table. Flag proves permission-aware retrieval was enforced (CBX{filter_retrieval}).

Room Title: Insecure LLM Tool and Plugin Use
Learning objectives: Explain how LLM agents call tools and plugins with delegated permissions | Identify excessive agency: over-broad scopes, missing confirmation and unvalidated arguments | Review a tool manifest and audit log to find a risky tool call | Apply least privilege, human approval for side effects and argument allow-lists
Practical lab description: Simulated AI agent console with a tool manifest (scopes per tool), tool-call audit log and a policy editor. Scenario/evidence & flag theme: Tools/evidence: tool manifest, agent tool-call audit log and policy editor. Flag proves tool scopes and approvals were fixed (CBX{scope_tools}).

Room Title: Using AI Assistants Safely in SOC and IR
